items.title: Sunset Pier Swap
items.description: Recast the main subject in this dramatic sunset pier scene with your own character while preserving the cinematic flow and environment.

variants.prompt:
Use the provided character reference as the exact identity and appearance guide. Replace the original young male character with mines ensuring he fits naturally into the scene.


Preserve his exact facial structure, hairstyle, clothing, accessories, skin tone and body proportions. Do not add a beanie, hoodie or any clothing that is not present in the reference.

ART STYLE AND VISUAL INTEGRATION



The character must share the same artistic rendering, lighting, texture and visual quality as the surrounding scene. Avoid photorealism, 3D rendering, plastic-looking skin, exaggerated anime proportions or a character-pasted-on appearance.

SCENE INTEGRATION

Make him fit the original scene’s perspective, scale, camera angles and physical environment. Adapt his posture and movements naturally to each shot while keeping his identity and outfit consistent.

Maintain the original cinematic storytelling, character interactions, background, environment and lighting. Ensure his clothing moves naturally with his body and that his hairstyle and sunglasses remain consistent across every frame.

FINAL REQUIREMENT

The result should look as though this character was originally designed for and animated within the scene. Preserve the character reference faithfully. Do not redesign, simplify, reinterpret or replace any of his defining features.

items.title: Speedboat Getaway Driver
items.description: Replace the driver of a high-speed boat in a cinematic neon city setting with any character or person of your choice.

variants.prompt:
Replace only the boat driver at the wheel in <<<video_1>>> with the character from <<<image_1>>>. Everything else in <<<video_1>>> stays exactly the same: the man in the palm-print shirt, the woman in the leather jacket, the boat, the pier, the buildings, the neon signs, the police, the light, the camera and the timing.

THE NEW DRIVER: the same face, hair, body shape, colors and outfit as in <<<image_1>>>, in every shot. The new driver copies every move of the original driver one to one: the grip on the wheel, the glances, the arm wave, the turn of the head and the chuckle, with the head at about the same height in the seat.

GRAPHICS MATCH (most important): whatever the style of <<<image_1>>> (a photo, a cartoon, anime, a 3D render or a drawing), the new driver is rendered in the exact video-game graphics of <<<video_1>>>, with the same shading, detail, sharpness, pink dusk and neon light, shadows and color grade as the man and the woman, so the new driver looks native to the same game and never pasted in. An animal keeps its own anatomy and rests plain paws on the wheel.

LIP-SYNC: the new driver's mouth moves exactly like the original driver's mouth and only there: "come on, come on" (1.6–3.6 s) and "Come on!" (7.3–8.4 s), then a short chuckle at the end.

NEVER: changes to anyone or anything except the driver, a mix of two faces, the driver cut off by the frame edge, size changes, a different art style, a pasted-in look, extra fingers, morphing.

items.title: Striker Shuffle
items.description: Swap the players in a high-stakes football match with different characters while maintaining the original jerseys and dynamic camera movements.

variants.prompt:
Replace the main player in the dark navy and neon-yellow kit — the one who dribbles the ball, chips the goalkeeper and scores — with the character from the reference image. Every other player in the video is also re-cast as a new, different person, described below. Every person must look clearly different from everyone else: no clones, no look-alikes, no repeated faces. The reference character's face, hair and shirt appear on the main player ONLY.

Cast:
1. MAIN PLAYER (with the ball): the character from the reference image.
2. GOALKEEPER (white/light-grey kit with gloves, dives at the ball at the start, later gets up and chases): a tall man in his mid-thirties with olive skin, a clean-shaved head and a short dark beard.
3. DEFENDER IN GREEN WHO COMES FROM BEHIND and challenges for the ball: a man with dark tan skin and a full thick black beard, short black hair.
4. DEFENDER IN GREEN WHO MAKES THE SLIDING TACKLE: a pale, fair-skinned man with freckles, a very short light-blond buzz cut and no beard.
5. PLAYER IN GREEN WITH LONG HAIR (appears around the main player during the dribble): a man with long dark-brown wavy hair down to the shoulders, light stubble, medium skin.
6. BLURRED PLAYER IN THE BACKGROUND IN THE FINAL SHOTS: a man with dark-brown skin, short curly black hair and a thin moustache, different from everyone above. He stays small and out of focus exactly as in the original.

All players keep their original kits, kit colors and numbers. Only faces, hair and skin change as described. Keep every movement exactly: runs, dribbles, touches, the chip, the goalkeeper's dive, the sliding tackle, falls, timing and ball physics frame by frame. Same shots, same cuts, same framing, camera movement, focus and depth of field. The ball, pitch, stadium, advertising boards, referees, stewards and the crowd stay identical to the original. No deformations of faces, bodies or limbs during fast motion and falls. Match the lighting, motion blur and grain so everyone looks naturally filmed. Fully photorealistic, each identity consistent in every frame.

items.title: Critter Garden Groove
items.description: Two anthropomorphic characters perform a synchronized, rhythmic dance on a lush lawn with high-energy movements and hand gestures.

variants.prompt:
[EDIT GOAL]

Recreate <<<video_1>>> with exactly two new animal characters: the ginger Maine Coon cat from and the grey pigeon from .

CRITICAL PRIORITY: Reproduce the original movement choreography from <<<video_1>>> as accurately as possible. Preserve the original rhythm, movement mechanics, body gestures, timing, pauses, trajectories, character interactions and comedic performance.

Change ONLY the characters and environment. Do not invent a new dance or reinterpret the original choreography.

[REFERENCE ROLES]

<<<video_1>>> — SOLE MOTION AND CHOREOGRAPHY MASTER.

<<<video_1>>> defines the complete sequence of movements, body poses, dance rhythm, limb gestures, character positions, relative distances, forward movement, timing, speed changes, pauses, camera behavior and final action.

Use ONLY its choreography and camera mechanics.

Do not copy the original rats’ appearance, alley, concrete walls, rubbish, lighting or background.

 — CHARACTER A: GINGER MAINE COON CAT.

Use as the strict identity reference for Character A.

Preserve its recognizable appearance: large ginger Maine Coon, thick reddish-orange fur, long pointed ears with prominent lynx-like tufts, broad muzzle, long white whiskers, large fluffy paws, expressive amber-green eyes and distinctive serious facial expression.

Maintain the same fur color, facial structure, proportions and recognizable identity throughout the entire video.

Do not inherit the indoor background, furniture, lighting, pose or camera framing from .

 — CHARACTER B: GREY PIGEON.

Use as the strict identity reference for Character B.

Preserve its grey plumage, dark grey head, iridescent green-purple neck feathers, orange eyes, black wing markings, pink feet, realistic beak and natural pigeon anatomy.

Do not inherit the dark studio background, lighting, pose or framing from .

[CHARACTER MAPPING]

Replace the foreground dancing rat from <<<video_1>>> with Character A, the ginger Maine Coon cat from .

Replace the background dancing rat from <<<video_1>>> with Character B, the grey pigeon from .

Each new character inherits ONLY the movement choreography of its corresponding original rat.

Maintain the same foreground/background relationships, movement paths and relative character positions.

Exactly ONE cat and ONE pigeon.

[LOCATION AND ENVIRONMENT]

A beautiful, realistic green lawn in a peaceful countryside garden.

Fresh, dense, naturally growing green grass, subtle uneven ground, soft daylight, distant green bushes and slightly blurred trees.

Both animals are physically present on the same lawn.

Natural contact shadows beneath their feet and paws.

Grass bends naturally under their weight.

The environment remains completely consistent throughout the video.

[VISUAL STYLE]

ULTRA-PHOTOREALISTIC LIVE-ACTION VIDEO.

The entire scene must look like a genuine viral smartphone video filmed spontaneously by a real person.

Natural handheld smartphone footage, authentic daylight, realistic exposure, natural motion blur, subtle handheld camera shake and realistic autofocus.

Highly detailed individual fur strands, realistic feather textures, physically accurate animal anatomy and natural lighting.

No CGI appearance, no cartoon rendering, no stylized animation, no artificial cinematic effects.

The animals must look completely real, even while performing the unusual dance choreography.

[MOTION INHERITANCE — ABSOLUTE PRIORITY]

Reproduce the complete dance choreography from <<<video_1>>>.

Every major movement must correspond to the original reference video.

Preserve:

* The exact order of body movements.
* The original alternating stepping rhythm.
* The original side-to-side body swaying.
* The original forward and backward weight transfers.
* The original rhythmic bouncing.
* The original torso rotations.
* The original alternating front-limb gestures.
* The original movement acceleration and deceleration.
* The original comedic pauses.
* The original forward approach toward the camera.
* The original ending movement.

CHARACTER A — MAINE COON:

The cat stands upright on its hind legs, just as the original foreground rat does.

Its hind paws reproduce the same alternating dance steps.

Its front paws reproduce the original rat’s arm gestures, including the same raising, lowering, swinging and rhythmic movements.

Its shoulders, torso, hips and head follow the original rat’s body movement pattern.

The cat maintains the same dance tempo, body swaying and forward momentum.

Its thick fur, whiskers and ear tufts react naturally to movement and acceleration.

Preserve the cat’s recognizable serious facial expression while allowing natural head movement and eye tracking.

CHARACTER B — PIGEON:

The pigeon stands upright on its two natural legs.

Its feet reproduce the original background rat’s stepping rhythm and movement trajectory.

Its body follows the same rhythmic swaying, bouncing and directional changes.

Its wings reproduce the original rat’s front-limb gestures as closely as anatomically possible.

The pigeon rhythmically raises, lowers and moves its wings in synchronization with the source choreography.

The pigeon must remain grounded throughout the entire dance.

No flying, hovering or unnecessary wing flapping.

IMPORTANT: Adapt movements only where required by the animals’ natural anatomy. Preserve the recognizable choreography, rhythm and comedic synchronization.

[CAMERA AND FRAMING]

Use <<<video_1>>> as the strict camera movement reference.

Preserve the original camera perspective, shot progression, framing changes, relative character scale and camera timing.

The camera behaves like a real handheld smartphone recording.

Maintain the original spatial relationship between the foreground and background characters.

As the cat approaches the camera, reproduce the same increase in apparent size and the same energetic close-up effect as the original foreground rat.

Use only natural handheld movement.

Do not introduce new camera angles, cinematic orbit shots, dramatic zooms, slow motion, artificial transitions or additional cuts.

[SCENE STRUCTURE]

STAGE 1 — OPENING MOVEMENT

Both animals begin in the same relative positions and movement phase as the original two rats in <<<video_1>>>.

Immediately reproduce the opening rhythmic stepping, upright body postures and alternating limb gestures.

The cat performs the foreground rat’s opening choreography.

The pigeon simultaneously performs the background rat’s opening choreography.

Maintain the same movement rhythm and initial spacing.

END STATE: Both animals continue the original dance sequence in their corresponding positions.

STAGE 2 — SYNCHRONIZED DANCE

Continue the choreography directly from the previous stage without resetting the movements.

The cat reproduces the original foreground rat’s rhythmic side-to-side movements, alternating paw gestures, body sways and stepping patterns.

The pigeon reproduces the original background rat’s corresponding movements using its feet, body and wings.

Maintain the same synchronization, movement speed and playful body dynamics.

Do not add new dance steps.

END STATE: Both animals maintain the original movement rhythm and relative positions.

STAGE 3 — APPROACH TO CAMERA

Reproduce the original foreground rat’s movement toward the camera using the Maine Coon cat.

Maintain the same forward stepping rhythm, body swaying, front-paw gestures and acceleration.

The pigeon continues the original background rat’s choreography.

Preserve the original camera relationship and character spacing.

The cat gradually occupies more of the frame as it approaches the lens.

END STATE: The cat reaches the same relative foreground position as the original rat.

STAGE 4 — FINAL CLOSE-UP

Reproduce the original ending choreography from <<<video_1>>>.

The Maine Coon moves close to the camera, matching the foreground rat’s final position, body orientation, movement rhythm and front-limb gestures.

The pigeon remains behind it, continuing the corresponding background choreography.

Preserve the same spontaneous, funny and energetic ending.

END STATE: The cat is close to the lens in the same final movement phase as the foreground rat, with the pigeon visible behind it.

[SOUND DESIGN]

Natural outdoor garden ambience.

Soft wind, distant birds, subtle grass rustling and realistic paw and foot contact with the lawn.

No dialogue. No added music. No cartoon sound effects.

[PHYSICAL REALISM]

Both animals must retain their natural recognizable anatomy.

The Maine Coon has four anatomically correct legs and paws, with its front paws used as dancing arms while standing on its hind legs.

The pigeon has exactly two legs and two wings.

No human hands, human arms or human body proportions.

Realistic balance adjustments, body weight, natural inertia, realistic foot placement, fur dynamics and feather movement.

All movements must appear physically continuous.

[CONSISTENCY LOCKS]

Exactly one Maine Coon cat from .

Exactly one grey pigeon from .

No additional animals.

No duplicated limbs.

No identity swapping.

No character morphing.

No environment changes.

No teleportation.

No random actions.

No invented choreography.

No changes to the original dance rhythm.

No subtitles, logos or text.

[FINAL PRIORITY RULE]

<<<video_1>>> controls ALL movement choreography, timing, rhythm, body gestures, action order and camera mechanics.

 controls ONLY the Maine Coon’s visual identity.

 controls ONLY the pigeon’s visual identity.

The new green lawn controls ONLY the environment.

The result must look like a genuine real-life viral smartphone recording of a Maine Coon cat and a grey pigeon performing the exact same recognizable dance choreography as the two original rats in <<<video_1>>>.

Movement fidelity is more important than cinematic beauty.

Photorealism is mandatory.

variants.prompt:
Replace the one dancing person in the source video with the person from the reference image. The reference image shows one person: copy that person's face, hairstyle, hair color, skin tone, body type and clothing exactly as in their photo, for the whole video. Do not invent or change their look.

Keep the source video's motion, timing, camera movement, framing, lens and lighting exactly. Normal real-time speed, exactly matching the source video timing, no slow motion, no speed-up, no time compression. One continuous handheld shot, no cuts.

THE DANCE: PERSON A copies the source dancer frame by frame — every step, foot slide, criss-cross, knee bend, shoulder move and arm swing at exactly the same moment and in the same direction. Same position in the frame and same walking path as the source.

WHO IS WHO:
- PERSON A = IMAGE 1: the one who dances and walks through the house, always in the center of the frame, followed by the camera.

PERSON A must NOT look like the dancer in the source video: no black balaclava, no ski mask, no face covering, no hood pulled over the head, no camouflage bomber jacket, no green camo print, no black gloves, no cargo pants with side pockets, no black boots, no beard — unless the same thing is visible in their own reference photo. Their face and hair are visible the whole time, hands are bare. Their clothing is exactly what they wear in the photo: no puffy bomber or padded jacket instead of it, nothing added that is not in the photo.

LOCATION AND OBJECTS (stay exactly as in the source, nothing redesigned):
- 0–15 s: huge luxury living room with very tall sheer white curtains, a black grand piano with a dark red floral-patterned lid and gold feet, a small black piano bench, a cream sofa with grey fur throws and gold sculptures, white stone floor with a black marble strip at the front.
- 15–19 s: the camera follows PERSON A to the right past dark wood and white marble pillars into a bright corridor.
- 19–29 s: open white kitchen and dining area — white cabinets, a big white marble island with bar stools, blue dining chairs, a modern chandelier, a grey sofa with dark blue patterned pillows on the right.

BACKGROUND PERSON stays as in the source and does not take the look of PERSON A: from about 22 s a second man lies stretched out on the grey sofa on the right, dressed all in black — black hoodie, black pants, black balaclava over his face. He stays exactly like that, still lying there, still all black, still wearing his black balaclava, never dressed like PERSON A. Nobody else in the house, no extra people.

Normal human anatomy, five fingers, same cool daylight color grade as the source, no text, no subtitles, no watermark.
